fields.notes: The single-pair amendments mandate the SNR/MSE observability + PAM3 transmitter test facilities; JTAG/scan/BIST are vendor-added. The SNR/MSE registers are the primary in-system DFT instrument; the OPEN Alliance defines the EMC + interoperability test methodology.

in_band_test_facilities.name: PAM3 transmitter test patterns (PMA)
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Emissions + jitter compliance for the single-pair PHY.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Master/slave force (MDIO)
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Force a role to characterise the channel.

internal_diagnostics_observability: PMA trained / PCS descrambler-lock / link-up status.
out_of_band_test_facilities: Automotive EMC chamber (radiated/conducted emissions + BCI immunity).
Single-pair channel VNA (return loss / insertion loss).
Automotive Ethernet protocol analyzer for frame + PLCA capture.
